query: I'm the PO for the fleet alerts product. Before I write the story for silencing alerts, interview me about it. Ask me everything a dev would need and don't let me get away with vague answers.
grill me on the scope of the 'export report to PDF' feature. I think I know what I want but every time we refine it the team finds holes. one question at a time is fine, or batches, your call
quero ser sabatinado sobre a decisão de encerrar alertas automaticamente depois de 24h. faz as perguntas que um QA e um dev fariam e anota os termos que a gente fechar no CONTEXT.md

act as the refinement facilitator: take the story in backlog/us-245-silence-alerts.md and run a question round with me as the product owner. Check the glossary in CONTEXT.md first so you don't ask me things that are already defined.
we keep disagreeing about what 'active alert' means on the dispatch team. walk me through questions until we have a definition we can both live with, then record it in the glossary
antes de eu levar essa história pro time, me faz as perguntas que faltam. ela tá em stories/us-318-encerrar-alerta.md e o glossário em CONTEXT.md. eu respondo como PO

I have a product decision to make: should the speed threshold be per vehicle or per route? Don't decide for me. Ask me the questions that expose what I haven't thought about, and tell me what you'd recommend based on what's in docs/.
run a requirements interview with me about the new driver onboarding flow. I'm the stakeholder. stop when you've got nothing left to ask and summarize the decisions
examine this scope statement with me like a skeptical senior engineer would: 'Phase 1 covers alert silencing for all vehicle types and all alert categories.' I'm the PO, I'll answer.
Before we finalize US-402 (Google login), question me on the edge cases. Look at previous stories in .scratch/ first so you only ask about what's not already settled.
write 10 interview questions I can ask candidates for a senior product owner role, focused on backlog prioritization and stakeholder management
summarize the decisions in this refinement meeting transcript (transcript-fleet-project.md) and list the open questions as a table
answer these questions from the PO about the alerts story: 1) can we silence per route? 2) what happens after 24h? use what's in the codebase in src/alerts/ to answer
escreve a história de usuário de silenciar alertas com critérios de aceite em Gherkin. Eu já decidi tudo: janela de 2h, por veículo, só o gestor pode silenciar. não precisa me perguntar nada
quiz me on Kubernetes networking concepts for my CKA exam, socratic style, don't give me the answers straight away
I'm preparing a FAQ for the alerts feature. generate the questions users are likely to ask and answer them from the docs in docs/features/alerts.md
help me decide between PostgreSQL and MongoDB for the alerts service. list the trade-offs with numbers where you can, I'll pick
faz uma retrospectiva com o time: eu colo as respostas do formulário (retro.csv) e você agrupa por tema e sugere 3 ações
my PO sent me a list of 14 questions about the API contract for the alerts endpoint. draft answers from the OpenAPI spec in api/openapi.yaml and flag the ones the spec doesn't cover
write a survey (Google Forms style, 8 questions, Likert scale) to collect feedback from dispatchers about the new alert screen
